items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: And little Sammy Hopkins, he used to sing with the show.

ctx.x: He was the entertainer. He was a comedian around there. Myrtle Jones, she was the blues singer around there.

And little Sammy Hopkins, he used to sing with the show. Followed by the name of Ferdinand Johnson was the master ceremony around there. Did they have any dancers? Well yeah, I used to have dance there after the show. No, no. I mean in the show. Did they have anybody doing any special kind of dancing in the show? Yeah. I'm trying to think who the followers was. I was.
I was. I was. I was. I was.
